WITH bucket_counts AS (
  SELECT o.timespan, COUNT(DISTINCT o.recordvault) AS order_count
  FROM riskandmargin AS r
  JOIN orders AS o ON r.ordervault = o.recordvault
  GROUP BY o.timespan
), shares AS (
  SELECT order_count * 1.0 / SUM(order_count) OVER () AS share
  FROM bucket_counts
), average_share AS (
  SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_share
  FROM shares
), kept AS (
  SELECT s.share, a.avg_share
  FROM shares AS s
  CROSS JOIN average_share AS a
  WHERE s.share > a.avg_share
)
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(1), 0) AS total_kept_bucket_count,
       AVG(share) AS average_share,
       AVG(share - avg_share) AS average_excess_share
FROM kept;

assumptions.assumption: SQLite groups all NULL timespan values into one bucket, and the total count is the sum of the per-bucket distinct-order counts.
